verdict.rationale: Snyk documents AI-generated suggestions drawn from the user's own code and dependencies. DeepCode AI powers security autofixes and context-aware risk scoring based on reachability and exploit maturity. The LLM-driven Remediation Agent scans the project, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies the fixes and verifies them. Missing for 10: no evidence of conversational or natural-language insight queries over findings inside the Snyk web product, no independent or hands-on corroboration of AI suggestion quality (the 85% accuracy figure is a vendor claim), and the agent experience is centered on coding assistants and the CLI rather than the platform UI.
